thread:
alex-support: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting per-model throughput charts are flatlined (zeros) in Console since ~22:10 UTC. Several escalations (TKT-834, TKT-837).
maria-platform: seeing it on our side too. Dashboard shows 0 rps for all models but raw metrics in prometheus look non-zero.
sam-ml: can you paste the grafana query you used?
alex-support: Query from dashboard: `sum(rate(redwood_per_model_throughput[5m])) by (model)` returns empty table in grafana, but `sum(rate(redwood_per_model_throughput[5m]))` returns total across all models.
lee-sre: interesting — that sounds like label key mismatch. We recently rolled model label normalization in the ingestion pipeline (PR #4521). Might have changed `model` -> `model_name` or appended `:vX` to values.
maria-platform: logs from the metrics-ingest show lines like: `metric=redwood_per_model_throughput labels=model_name="gpt-open-8k:v2" value=...` whereas the dashboards are still grouped by `model`.
sam-ml: quick test: on infra box running promql locally — `label_replace(sum(rate(redwood_per_model_throughput[5m])), "model", "$1", "model_name", "(.*):v.*")` returns per-model series. So label_replace workaround works.
lee-sre: good catch. Short term fix: update grafana panels to use fallback to model_name with label_replace wrapper. I'll open a patch.
maria-platform: FYI support is being pinged by two enterprise customers asking for ETA. Can we prioritize a hotfix to dashboards (config-only) rather than touching exporters?
lee-sre: agreed. config-only change in dashboards is lowest risk — will push update to dashboards repo and redeploy grafana provisioning.
alex-support: can you also add a temporary note in Console 'Metrics known issue' banner so customers know we're on it?
deploy-bot: deploy started for dashboards-provisioning prod -> canary at 1742730600
sam-ml: longer-term we should keep both labels for backwards compatibility or add aliasing in the ingest pipeline. I'll file a follow-up RFC.
maria-platform: adding repro steps for SRE: 1) run promql `sum(rate(redwood_per_model_throughput[5m])) by (model)` and observe empty; 2) run `sum(rate(redwood_per_model_throughput[5m]))` to confirm non-zero total; 3) run label_replace query to verify label key change.
lee-sre: patch merged to dashboards repo -> config updated to use label_replace fallback. Redeploy completed to canary, looks good. Will roll to prod in 15m.
alex-support: thanks — I notified TKT-834 & TKT-837 owners and posted temporary banner. Customers acknowledged.
maria-platform: after prod roll I'll open a tiny instrumentation revert or alias at ingest so we don't need label_replace forever. Need approval from product for metric contract change.
sam-ml: RFC created: rfc/2024-metric-label-compat.md
lee-sre: PROD rollout finished at 1742732701 — graphs back to normal for canary + prod, closing incident.
alex-support: closing loop with customers. Great job team :thumbsup:
